summary: The product-catalog service is experiencing severe memory starvation, causing extreme latency and cascading failures throughout the application.

root_cause.description: The product-catalog service is suffering from severe memory starvation (99.65% usage), leading to extreme latency and cascading timeouts across the application.

evidence.explanation: The product-catalog container is at 99.65% memory usage, which is extremely high and likely causing performance degradation.
Traces show that requests to the product-catalog service are taking over 50 seconds to complete, which is the root cause of the high latency observed across the application.

rejected_evidence.explanation: The product-catalog service is experiencing extreme latency (p95 15000ms) and is consuming nearly all its allocated memory (99.65%). This is causing downstream timeouts in the frontend and other services.

The astronomy-db is healthy and not the bottleneck, as its CPU and memory usage are within normal limits.

prevention: Increase memory limits for the product-catalog service to handle the current load and prevent memory-related performance degradation. Investigate if there is a memory leak or inefficient query handling in the product-catalog service.
